verdict.rationale: The official E2B GitHub README says installing the Desktop SDK gives mouse, keyboard, screenshot, application, and desktop streaming APIs. That indicates a full desktop environment can run in the sandbox. Custom templates with a chosen base image and start command (e2b-docs-17) could plausibly host a browser, but this is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit headless-browser support or docs, in-depth Desktop SDK documentation beyond a one-line README mention, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
